body.statement: For the fixed slack \(\eta>0\), \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}P\{(c,W(\theta_c),K(\theta_c))\in\widehat{\mathcal T}_n\text{ for every }c\in\mathcal C\}\ge1-\alpha\). Consequently, for every measurable selected preference \(\widehat c\in\mathcal C\), \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}P\{(\widehat c,W(\theta_{\widehat c}),K(\theta_{\widehat c}))\in\widehat{\mathcal T}_n\}\ge1-\alpha\).
body.justification: The simultaneous event protects arbitrary data-dependent choice from the plotted curve without asserting conditional coverage after selection.
body.gap: PolicyLearningWithConfidence2026 gives a general reporting-guarantee selection rule; this result instead covers the entire structural welfare--KL menu and every measurable selector from it.
body.consumer: A planner may inspect all commitment-savings tradeoffs and choose a preference afterward while retaining the advertised unconditional coverage.
